data.gender_notes: Ritika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'riti', meaning 'value' or 'rule'. In Hindu mythology, Ritika is the name of the divine goddess of speech and knowledge. She is the embodiment of wisdom, eloquence, and beauty. The name signifies a beloved or favorite one, cherished for her virtues and intelligence. The name Ritika carries the meaning “Beloved, Favorite” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ritika usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved, favorite and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of speech and knowledge.
data.etymology: Ritika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beloved, Favorite.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ritika total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
